rationale: The assistant kept everything unplugged, hedged sensibly between 'worn jockey/idler pulley or belt' and 'drum support roller, bearing/bush or felt support', and handed off to an engineer with a good one-line description once the customer said they could not tilt the machine. It never fabricated evidence and recommended no parts. However it never asked for the model number (which the customer knew), never checked levelling despite this being the sensible first step and the machine rocking on a wooden floor, and did not try to localise the noise or rule out the condensate pump; the drum-lift check was also not answerable for this customer.
